title: Roads/ Highway Design Engineer
description:
Water Engineering
UKIMEA Region

DEL000055 Requisition \#  

**Joining Arup**
  

  

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Arup is a UK\-headquartered independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants, and technical specialists offering a wide range of professional services. With 90 offices in 35 countries, their 19,000\+ staff make a positive difference in the world through their work.  

  

  



**The Opportunity**


This is an exciting opportunity to join teams delivering major infrastructure and water projects in India, the UK, Middle East and Africa. The modeller needs to have experience with geometric design standards, which is also standard industry practice in highways projects. Your expertise in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and GIS will be critical to the success of our design and construction teams
**Is this role right for you?**


We are looking for individuals who:


* 10\+ years of experience in road and street design, preferably on Indian projects, with UK project exposure as an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of road geometric design standards such as IRC and DMRB.
* Experience in detailed design, drainage design, reports, calculations, and BOQ preparation.
* Proficient in AutoCAD, Civil 3D, and GIS; OpenRoads Designer experience is an added advantage.
* Experienced in developing design layouts, grading plans, and as\-built documentation
* Ability to work closely with engineers and multidisciplinary teams to deliver accurate designs
* Familiar with traffic signs, road markings, vehicle restraint systems, and road safety audits (desirable).
* Ensures compliance with CAD standards, quality requirements, and data management procedures.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and capable of delivering high\-quality work with minimal supervision.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement and innovation.
* Comfortable working in dynamic, collaborative project environments while maintaining confidentiality.

Not ready to apply just yet, or have a few questions? Contact (Nisha.Gulati\-nisha.gulati@arup.com). Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.


**Reward and Benefits**


We offer a competitive salary at all levels, and one of the best benefits packages in our sector. Core benefits include Provident Fund contribution, NPS option, Mediclaim cover (incl. family), Term Life and Accident Insurance, Employee Assistance Prog. scheme for the family to safeguard your physical and mental wellbeing. In addition, all permanent employees are eligible for the Global Profit Share scheme. Subject to scheme rules employees can receive two Profit Share payments per year, which are dependent on the firm’s financial performance.


**Different people, shared values.**


At Arup, we believe when talented people collaborate, great things are possible. Arup hires people with proven skills and open minds. We are taking deliberate action to create an inclusive culture that is grounded in our purpose to shape a better world.


At Arup, we welcome candidates from all backgrounds, regardless of age, disability, gender, gender identity, gender expression, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and any other protected characteristic. Our internal employee networks \- BAME, Culture, Disability, LGBTQ\+ and Women \- provide a space for you to express your views and to make a positive difference \- discover more about life at Arup here.


At Arup, we are committed to making all stages of our recruitment process accessible to candidates with disabilities. Please speak to our recruitment team and we will work with you to make reasonable adjustments to ensure you can perform at your best throughout your application.


At Arup, we appreciate that everyone’s circumstances are different and having the freedom to flex the way we work is essential to our wellbeing. If flexibility matters to you let us know when you apply, and we will discuss how this could work in your role.


**What happens next?**


If this could be the next step in your journey, please apply online. All applications will be considered, and we will try our very best to respond to you within 72 hours of receiving your application.


Stay safe online \- Arup will never ask for payment or your bank details as part of our recruitment process


Recruitment Agencies \- We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

  

We may close the role earlier than the advertised date should we receive a large number of applications, so please ensure you apply early.

title: Purchase Manager
description:
**Position Overview:**

The Purchase and Procurement Manager will play a pivotal role in developing and managing the end\-to\-end procurement function. This role demands a strategic, detail\-oriented professional who can build procurement processes from scratch, negotiate with suppliers, and ensure timely availability of materials and services critical to project success.

**Key responsibilities**

· Develop and implement purchasing policies, procedures, and guidelines to streamline procurement activities.

· Identify, evaluate, and negotiate with suppliers and vendors to secure the best quality materials and services at competitive prices.

· Establish and maintain strong supplier relationships and develop a reliable vendor base.

· Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and finance teams to forecast material requirements and budget adherence.

· Manage purchase orders, contracts, and procurement documentation ensuring accuracy and compliance.

· Monitor inventory levels and optimize stock to avoid delays and excess holding costs.

· Conduct market research to stay updated on industry trends, pricing, and new suppliers.

· Implement cost\-saving initiatives without compromising quality or timelines.

· Ensure timely delivery of materials and services to meet project schedules.

· Lead and mentor procurement staff as the team grows in the future.

· Prepare regular reports on procurement status, supplier performance, and cost analysis for senior management.

· Team Management and Problem solver, should be a good decision maker.

**Requirements:**

· Min. 7 years of relevant procurement experience, from **real estate**, construction, or infrastructure sectors.

· In\-depth knowledge of building materials, supplier networks, and construction supply chain logistics.

· Proven experience in managing procurement teams and leading cross\-functional collaboration.

· Strong negotiation, analytical, and decision\-making skills.

· Familiarity with procurement software/ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.).

· Strong command over Excel

**Interested candidates can share their resume at 9218021508**

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Product Engineer (Field Tools)
description:
**Starting Date:** December 2026

**Contract type:** Full\-time and open\-ended

**Salary:** From 2,716,737 INR

**Location:** India; Delhi, Ahmedabad (Hybrid)

**Application closing date:** 8th October 2026

 *If we receive a high volume of applications, we may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.*

 **About the Job**

  

The Product Engineer designs and builds the digital products that farmers, field teams, programme partners, and BCI teams rely on to collect data and carry out field activities. The role combines product judgement, design sensibility, and hands\-on software engineering to turn field and programme requirements into simple, reliable products in production. The Product Engineer is key strengthening the quality and usability of Better Cotton's field\-facing digital tools and, in turn, the efficiency of field operations across our programme geographies.

 **The Challenge**

  

Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

 **Responsibilities**


In this role, you will be responsible for :

* Review and stress\-test requirements from subject\-matter experts and programme teams, identifying unclear assumptions and unnecessary complexity before build begins.
* Partner with the Product Designer to shape simple, effective user flows for mobile, offline, and multilingual field use.
* Translate agreed solutions into clear, prioritised, testable delivery increments, and build high\-quality features across frontend, backend, and data layers.
* Use AI coding agents throughout prototyping, development, testing, and debugging to accelerate delivery without compromising quality, security, or maintainability.
* Write automated tests and instrument products to track adoption, performance, and reliability in real\-world field conditions.
* Release features safely, support their rollout, and iterate based on field feedback and product usage data.
* Work collaboratively with the line manager to set clear, outcome\-based objectives that align with function\-wide and organisational goals.
* Take ownership of agreed objectives, ensuring alignment with team priorities and performance expectations.

 **Experience**

  

the following skills, knowledge, and experience:

 **Essential:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience, with a strong track record of personally building, shipping, and improving production digital products that users value and rely on; evidence of judgement, scope, and delivery matters more than tenure.
* Experience taking products from prototype through production, rollout, and continuous improvement.
* Strong product and interaction\-design judgement, gained working closely with designers and subject\-matter experts.
* Experience using AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) as a core part of development, testing, debugging, and code review.
* Experience testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production applications.
* Experience with agriculture, field operations, offline products, multilingual interfaces, geospatial workflows, or products for users with varying digital literacy is valuable.
* Experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and related frontend technologies.
* Experience developing backend services, APIs, and databases using Python (or a comparable language), SQL, and cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Fluency in written and spoken English is essential.

  

Desirable:

* Proficiency in Hindi, Urdu, Swahili, or other relevant languages would be advantageous.

 **What we offer**

* Hybrid working opportunity, with the office days based in Delhi.
* The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year
* Flexible working, with core hours from 10 am to 4 pm local time
* Continuous learning and development
* Pension scheme
* A generous annual leave package, including paid holiday, public holidays, additional paid days off during the festive season, study and exam days, and extra discretionary leave for life events such as family weddings or moving home
* Enhanced parental benefits
* The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.

 **Working arrangements**

  

The position is full\-time (40 hours per week) and will be based in Delhi. Better Cotton Initiative offers flexible working, with core hours being 10 am – 4 pm. The position may require limited international travel.

 **Apply now**

  

Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1\-page maximum) by or before **08\.10\.2026** via the application link.

  

In your cover letter, please include an explanation of why your experience is specifically relevant to this role at Better Cotton Initiative. We want to see your personal style – what makes you tick and why you think your next opportunity is here with us.

  

Better Cotton Initiative does not use artificial intelligence or in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human\-led assessment experience.

 **Our hiring process**

 **Initial Screening:**


Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicant. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.

 **Interviews:**


If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton Initiative may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management. As an internal candidate, you may have discussions regarding your current responsibilities and how they will transition to the new position.

 **Assessment and Testing:**


Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position. Internal candidates may have the option to demonstrate their existing skills through current job performance or past project outcomes.

 **Reference Checks:**


Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications, and for some roles, your education and criminal history. Internal candidates may be asked for references from current or previous supervisors within Better Cotton Initiative to provide insights into their performance and capabilities.

 **Offer stage:**


After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If you are selected and your references are relevant and satisfactory, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details. For internal candidates, the offer process may include a discussion about how your transition to the new role will be managed and any support needed for a smooth handover.

 **About Better Cotton** **Initiative**


Better Cotton Initiative is a global not\-for\-profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand. In just 15 years we have aligned more than a fifth of the world’s cotton with our standard and helped farmers and farming communities thrive. Join us in building a better, more sustainable future for cotton worldwide.

 **About our Values**


The post holder will be expected to operate in line with our workplace values which are:

* **Trustworthy** (including honest, transparent, credible)
* As having **Integrity** (including responsible, authentic)
* **Positive** (including problem\-solving, pragmatic)
* **Engaging** (including adaptable, inclusive, holistic)
* **Daring** (including courageous, innovative, game\-changing)

 **Being you @ Better Cotton** **Initiative**

  

Better Cotton Initiative is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources.

  

We have a zero\-tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. Safeguarding incidents are acts of serious misconduct and are grounds for disciplinary action, up to and including, dismissal and referral to relevant authorities for criminal prosecution. Therefore, all offers of employment are subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks.

title: Electrical Design Engineer
description:
We are seeking a skilled and motivated Primary Design Engineer with 5–7 years of experience in the UK power distribution sector. The candidate will be responsible for the design and delivery of primary electrical infrastructure projects (up to 400kV), supporting DNO/IDNO/ICP clients including UKPN, SSEN, and others. The role requires strong technical expertise, familiarity with UK standards, and the ability to deliver high\-quality design solutions within project timelines.

Key Duties and Responsibilities Your responsibilities will include the following.

 Design of primary substations and electrical networks (up to 400kV)

 Preparation of:  Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)  General Arrangement (GA) drawings  Equipment layouts and earthing designs  Cable routing and termination layouts  Perform primary plant design calculations, including:  Earthing design studies  Equipment sizing and selection  Busbar design and insulation coordination  Ensure compliance with UK DNO/IDNO standards, including UKPN, SSEN, ENA, and IEC standards  Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams (Protection \& Control, Civil, Planning)  Liaise with clients, contractors, and internal stakeholders  Conduct design reviews and ensure quality assurance  Provide technical guidance to junior engineers

Key Skills \& Competencies

 Strong understanding of UK power distribution standards and specifications

 Experience with DNO/IDNO/ICP projects (e.g., UKPN, SSEN frameworks)  Knowledge of: o Substation layouts and primary equipment o Transformers, switchgear, CTs/VTs o Earthing systems and design tools  Familiarity with relevant standards: o ENA Engineering Recommendations o IEC / BS standards  Proficiency in engineering tools such as: o AutoCAD o ETAP / ELEK / CDEGS (or equivalent)  Good understanding of health \& safety regulations (CDM Regulations preferred)  Strong communication and documentation skills

Qualification

 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent  5–7 years of relevant experience in UK utility or consultancy environment  Experience working on UKPN, SSEN, or other DNO frameworks  Exposure to IDNO/ICP connection projects  Experience in site support, commissioning, or construction interface

Pay: ₹11,041\.91 \- ₹34,877\.20 per month

Work Location: In person

title: L1 Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**

We are looking for a proactive and technically skilled **L1 Support Engineer** to join our IT support team. The ideal candidate will have minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience in **Active Directory network troubleshooting**, **basic server maintenance**, and **desktop/laptop support**. You will be the first point of contact for users facing IT issues and will play a key role in maintaining seamless IT operations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide Level 1 support for network, server, and desktop\-related issues.
* Monitor and manage LAN/WAN infrastructure and resolve basic network connectivity issues.
* Assist with basic server maintenance (e.g., user creation, permission management, backups).
* Installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of desktops, laptops, printers, and peripherals.
* Operating system support (Windows 10/11, basic Linux knowledge is a plus).
* Handle ticketing system, log incidents, and ensure timely resolution/escalation.
* Coordinate with L2/L3 engineers for escalated issues.
* Maintain IT inventory and asset records.
* Provide on\-site support for users in the South Delhi office and remote support if needed.

**Required Skills:**

* **Basic understanding of network concepts (IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, etc.).**
* **Familiarity with Windows Server and Active Directory basics.**
* **Experience with hardware troubleshooting and software installations.**
* **Knowledge of antivirus tools, patch updates, and system imaging.**
* **Strong communication and interpersonal skills.**
* **Ability to work independently and within a team.**

**Qualification:**

* Diploma / Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: From ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Analyst, Incident Management
description:
Overview:
**WELCOME TO SITA**
-------------------

  

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.  

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting\-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward\-we're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.  

Are you ready to love your job?  

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.**PURPOSE**
-----------


Coordinates and oversees the resolution of critical incidents ensuring minimal business impact and swift restoration of services through structured processes and effective communication (and triggers crisis management process).**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

* As Senior Analyst, Incident Management, you will serve as the operational control tower for Major Incidents and Priority 1 incidents across the Digital Customer Organization (DCO) and Portfolio Service Operations (PSO). You will establish command and control, coordinate the right technical and business resources, and maintain a disciplined focus on restoring customer services while minimizing operational, financial, reputational, and customer impact.
* You will be accountable for the quality and pace of end\-to\-end major incident governance, including impact assessment, stakeholder mobilization, technical and customer bridge management, escalation, communications, recovery validation, documentation, and post\-incident follow\-through. You will support the accountable Incident Manager and ensure that resolver teams retain ownership of technical diagnosis and remediation.
* Reporting to the Manager, Major Incident Management, you will be part of the Digital Customer Organization (DCO)function responsible for service resilience, customer confidence, consistent global incident response, and the continued transformation and maturity of Incident Management.
* You will collaborate with DCO Service Desks, PSO resolver teams, Customer Service Managers (CSO), Site Reliability Engineers (SRE), Service Practice Owners, Product and Engineering teams, Problem Management, Change Enablement, Vendor Management (VMO), suppliers, and senior stakeholders. Through these partnerships, you will strengthen DCO and PSO integration, improve operational handovers, and convert incident learning into sustainable service improvements.
* Lead and coordinate Major Incidents and P1 incidents from declaration through service restoration and formal closure, maintaining a clear command structure, accurate situational awareness, and momentum toward recovery.
* Rapidly evaluate technical, customer, and business impact; validate priority; initiate the appropriate Major Incident or crisis pathway; and ensure compliance with agreed SLAs, OLAs, customer commitments, and escalation procedures.
* Mobilize and coordinate DCO, PSO, SRE, Product, Engineering, vendor, supplier, and specialist resolver teams, establishing clear accountabilities, time\-bound actions, dependencies, and escalation points.
* Establish and facilitate technical, customer, and management bridges, keeping discussions outcome\-focused, recording decisions and actions, challenging stalled progress, and escalating risks, resource gaps, or conflicting priorities.
* Deliver accurate, concise, and timely communications for customers, operations, senior leadership, and executives, clearly presenting impact, recovery actions, workarounds, risks, assumptions, estimated next updates, and service status.
* Maintain a complete and auditable incident record in the ITSM platform, including business impact, chronology, ownership, decisions, evidence, communications, recovery validation, links to related Problems and Changes, and closure details.
* Produce high\-quality Post\-Major Incident Reports (PMIRs), executive summaries, and post\-incident review packs; facilitate blameless learning reviews that identify control gaps, contributing factors, and practical opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate Root Cause Analysis and Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) with Problem Management and technical owners, ensuring actions are risk\-based, measurable, assigned, due\-dated, tracked, and closed only after effectiveness is verified.
* Analyze incident performance and trends, including MTTA, MTTR, SLA compliance, repeat incidents, business impact, communication timeliness, escalation quality, action ageing, and customer feedback; translate insights into prioritized improvement plans.
* Advance the maturity of Incident Management through playbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, templates, simulations, training, automation opportunities, governance reviews, and stronger integration across DCO, PSO, SRE, CSO, VMO, and Service Practices.


Qualifications:
**EXPERIENCE**
--------------


Preferably 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in a customer\-focused service or support role within a large\-scale enterprise environment. Experience should include Customer Support, Service Desk, Help Desk, Call Centre, Incident Management, Service Operations, NOC, Command Centre, or IT Operations. **NICE TO HAVE*** ITIL 4 Foundation/Practitioner, SRE, Agile, DevOps, Lean, Six Sigma, or related Service Management certifications.
* Experience supporting mission\-critical environments such as aviation, travel technology, telecommunications, cloud services, managed infrastructure, SaaS platforms, or financial services, with exposure to executive communications, crisis management, and business continuity processes.
* Hands\-on experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, observability and monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, etc), operational analytics, AI Ops, and Incident Management transformation initiatives.
  

Candidates should demonstrate strong customer engagement skills and practical experience supporting a broad range of services and products at intermediate to advanced levels. Experience or working knowledge of airline and travel industry operations, applications, and customer service environments is highly desirable.**KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS**
-----------------------

**IT Service Management Knowledge**

* Advanced practical understanding of ITIL\-based Incident and Major Incident Management, including interfaces with Problem, Change, Event, Knowledge, Service Level and Continual Improvement practices.
* Understanding of service management governance, SLAs/OLAs, operational acceptance, service transition, risk and control frameworks.
* Proficiency with enterprise ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or equivalent, collaboration tools, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories.
* Strong command of RCA methods including 5 Whys, fishbone analysis, fault\-tree thinking, timeline analysis and contributory\-factor analysis.

**Technical Knowledge**


* Broad operational understanding of enterprise networks, LAN/WAN, MPLS, SD\-WAN, VPN, DNS, load balancing, firewalls and connectivity services.
* Working knowledge of cloud, data centre, virtualization, compute, storage, databases, middleware, messaging, APIs, identity, monitoring and application support.
* Ability to interpret monitoring alerts, logs, service dependencies, transaction flows, change records and technical recovery plans.
* Awareness of cybersecurity incident interfaces, business continuity, disaster recovery and regulated or safety\-critical service environments.
* Ability to lead technical specialists effectively without being the deepest subject\-matter expert in every technology domain.

**Management \& Interpersonal Skills**

* Exceptional incident leadership, command\-and\-control, facilitation and prioritization under time pressure.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including executive summaries and customer\-facing updates.
* Strong analytical reasoning, structured problem solving, attention to evidence and disciplined decision\-making.
* Influencing, negotiation and conflict\-resolution capability across teams with competing priorities and no direct reporting relationship.
* Cultural awareness and effectiveness in a global, virtual and matrix organization.

**PROFESSION COMPETENCIES**
---------------------------

**Major Incident Leadership:** Establishes control rapidly, sets priorities, drives decisions and maintains momentum until stable service is verified.

**Customer \& Business Orientation:** Understands business impact and balances technical recovery, operational risk, contractual commitments and customer experience.

**Operational Excellence:** Applies repeatable controls, accurate records, measurable standards and evidence\-based governance.

**Problem Solving \& Judgement:** Synthesizes incomplete information, challenges assumptions and makes timely, risk\-informed decisions.

**Process Integration:** Connects incident learning to Problem, Change, Knowledge, Event, Service Level and Continual Improvement outcomes.

**Transformation \& Improvement:** Identifies systemic gaps and converts lessons into sustainable improvements, automation and improved ways of working.

**Stakeholder Leadership:** Influences global teams, suppliers, customers and leaders through credibility, clarity and constructive challenge.

**Data \& Insight:** Uses operational metrics, trends and quality analysis to target improvements and demonstrate benefits.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**
---------------------

* Accountability and ownership
* Customer centricity
* Collaboration and inclusion
* Integrity and professional courage
* Agility and resilience
* Strategic and systems thinking
* Results orientation
* Learning mindset and continuous improvement
* Composure under pressure
* Attention to detail and quality

**EDUCATION \& QUALIFICATIONS**
-------------------------------

title: Senior Detection Engineer
description:
Talanos Cybersecurity delivers managed SOC, identity governance, third\-party risk management, dark web intelligence, continuous autonomous pentesting and security advisory services to mid\-market and regulated organisations across the UK, Europe, South Africa, Botswana and India. We are CREST SOC accredited and certified ISO 27001 and ISO 9001\.

We are building a dedicated Detection Engineering function and this is its founding role. We need someone who can engineer detections across enterprise SIEM platforms and who can also understand a customer's business well enough to know which detections actually matter to them. You will work across multiple SIEM platforms and sectors, with direct access to the CTO and real influence over our in\-house product roadmap.

**What you'll be doing**

* Baseline and improve detection coverage for assigned customers against MITRE ATT\&CK and their own risk profile
* Author, test, version and maintain detection content across multiple SIEM platforms
* Determine the log sources and telemetry needed for a given detection outcome and troubleshoot integrations, parsers and data quality
* Work directly with customers to translate their business risk into monitoring requirements a SOC analyst can act on
* Build the correlation layer that connects our security services to one another (e.g. turning dark web credential exposures into tuned identity detections)
* Track the threat landscape and build a reusable detection library so work for one customer raises the baseline for all

**What you'll need**

*You don't need to tick every box below, but most of these should describe you:*

* 6\+ years in cybersecurity, with real hands\-on experience in security operations, SIEM engineering or detection content
* Deep, practical experience with at least one enterprise SIEM (e.g. Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, Elastic Security, Google SecOps, Sumo Logic) and confidence working across more than one
* Demonstrable experience authoring detection logic in a query language such as KQL, SPL, EQL, Lucene, YARA\-L or Sigma
* Strong working knowledge of MITRE ATT\&CK used for coverage and gap analysis, not just as a reporting label
* Practical understanding of log sources across Windows, Linux, cloud platforms, identity systems, network, email and EDR
* Ability to hold a credible conversation with a customer about their business and convert it into monitoring requirements
* Clear written and spoken English

**Nice to have**

* Python or PowerShell scripting; detection\-as\-code workflows using Git and CI pipelines
* Purple team experience, or use of Atomic Red Team, Caldera or a commercial breach and attack simulation platform
* Structured, hypothesis\-driven threat hunting experience
* Identity security experience (identity governance, privileged access, privileged account monitoring)
* Cloud or detection certifications (AZ\-500, SC\-200, AWS Security Specialty, GCDA, GCIA, GCFA, GCED, OSCP)

**What we offer**

* Genuine ownership of a new discipline, reporting directly to the CTO
* Breadth across multiple customers, sectors and SIEM platforms
* A funded training and certification budget
* Standard business hours, no shift work and no on\-call rota (with regular calls overlapping into the UK afternoon/evening, roughly 1:30pm\-9:30pm IST)
* A clear path to leading the function as it grows

To apply, please submit your CV along with a short note on one detection you personally designed and built: what it was for, what evidence it relied on, and how you knew it worked.

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹250,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* Describe a detection you personally designed and built. What was it for, what evidence did it rely on, how did you confirm it worked?
* Which SIEM platform(s) have you personally authored detection content in (not just administered), and which query language(s) have you used (e.g. KQL, SPL, Sigma)?
* How many years of hands\-on experience do you have specifically authoring or maintaining detection logic, as distinct from monitoring or triaging alerts?
* Give an example of a time you explained a security risk or detection gap to a non\-technical stakeholder or customer. What was the situation and how did you approach it?
* This role involves occasional travel to Delhi (roughly once a month) and regular working hours that overlap into the UK afternoon/evening (approx. 1:30pm\-9:30pm IST). Are you comfortable with this?
* What is your current notice period?

### **Job Description**


**Job Description – Network \& System Engineer**
================================================

**Position**
------------

**Network \& System Engineer**  

  



**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a skilled **Network \& System Engineer** responsible for designing, deploying, configuring, monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintaining network and IT infrastructure for our infra and clients. The candidate should have hands\-on experience with networking, Linux/Windows systems, virtualization platforms, firewalls, routers, switches, SAN infrastructure, hardware, and IT support.  

  



The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in client environments, handling infrastructure deployments, resolving technical issues, and ensuring high availability and performance of IT infrastructure.  

  



**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Network Infrastructure**

* Design, configure, deploy, and maintain enterprise network infrastructure.
* Hands\-on experience with **Cisco, Fortinet, and other routers, switches, and network security devices**.
* Configure and troubleshoot **LAN/WAN, VLANs, routing, switching, VPN, NAT, DHCP, DNS, and basic network security**.
* Understand and prepare **network topology and infrastructure diagrams**.
* Perform network troubleshooting, performance analysis, and issue resolution.
* Experience with **SAN switches** and storage/network connectivity.
* Implement and maintain network infrastructure at our and client locations.
* Coordinate with vendors and clients for network deployment, troubleshooting, and support.

### **Firewall \& Security**

* Hands\-on experience with deployment, configuration, and troubleshooting of **Fortinet firewalls**.
* Working knowledge of **Fortinet,** **Cisco and other firewall/security solutions**.
* Configure security policies, NAT, VPN, access controls, and related firewall services.
* Monitor security and network events and troubleshoot connectivity/security issues.

### **Linux \& System Administration**

* Hands\-on experience with **Linux server installation, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting**.
* Troubleshoot Linux OS, services, networking, storage, permissions, logs, and performance\-related issues.
* Working knowledge of **Windows and basic system administration**.
* Experience with system deployment, patching, backup, and maintenance activities.
* Good understanding of server hardware and associated components.

### **Virtualization**

* Hands\-on experience with **VMware virtualization technologies**.
* Experience with **Proxmox VE** for virtualization and virtual machine management.
* Deployment, configuration, migration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of virtual machines.
* Understanding of virtual networking, storage, resource allocation, and high availability concepts.

### **IT Infrastructure \& Support**

* Provide **L1/L2/L3 technical support** for network and system infrastructure, as required.
* Troubleshoot desktops, laptops, servers, networking equipment, printers, and other IT hardware.
* Knowledge of **server, desktop, laptop, storage, and networking hardware**.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot IT infrastructure at client locations.
* Maintain proper documentation of infrastructure, configurations, incidents, and changes.
* Participate in infrastructure deployment, upgrades, migration, and maintenance activities.

### **Monitoring \& Maintenance**

* Experience with **network and server monitoring tools/software**.
* Monitor availability, performance, CPU, memory, storage, bandwidth, and network devices.
* Proactively identify and resolve infrastructure issues before they impact clients.
* Generate and maintain monitoring reports and infrastructure health reports.
* Perform regular preventive maintenance and health checks.

**Certification**
-----------------

* **CCNA certification is required.**
* Additional certifications in **Fortinet, VMware, Linux, or other relevant technologies** will be an advantage.

**Experience**
--------------

* **2–5 years of relevant experience** in Network/System Administration or IT Infrastructure.
* Candidates with hands\-on experience in **client infrastructure deployment and support** will be preferred.

**Key Competencies**
--------------------

* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and client\-handling skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of an infrastructure team.
* Willingness to travel to **client sites** when required.
* Ability to work under pressure and handle critical infrastructure issues.
* Good documentation and reporting skills.
* Strong focus on service quality, uptime, and customer satisfaction.
